finalText:
It builds clean now. The link stage was crashing because `resolveConfig` in `src/core/settings.js` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, so every build died right after the compile phase.

Fixed that one line, and now it finishes with 0 errors: `retries 3` resolves correctly and both bundle files emit.

The three warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) are just noise from the fake compiler script and don't block the build — let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
